title: Struck timetable, live countdown beside it
description: Replace the pill with the scheduled clock time struck through, immediately before the live countdown: '07:50' (line-through) '4 min'. Makes 'the timetable said X, it is really running later' unmistakable — a natural fit for the floor-at-schedule / never-earlier rule, since eta is always >= scheduledEta.
baseline_ref: app/components/ArrivalRow.vue: .arrival-row__scheduled renders 'HH:mm →' as a muted prefix; the estimado pill sits by the headsign

changes.intent: Drop the '→' arrow and the pill; keep only the scheduled clock time, now struck through.
changes.detail: Remove the .arrival-row__badge--estimated pill. Keep the .arrival-row__scheduled span driven by scheduledTimeDisplay but render just the 'HH:mm' (no ' →'). The live countdown number stays as-is right after it.

changes.intent: Strike the superseded timetable time so it reads as 'no longer holds', keeping it muted against the live number.
